metadata.title: Disaster Recovery

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for restoring services after large-scale outages or catastrophic disruption.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for recovering critical systems and services following regional or infrastructure-scale failures.

props.name: threat-framework
props.remarks: Disaster recovery mitigates the impact of ATT&CK availability and impact-oriented attacks.

props.name: defense-framework
props.remarks: Disaster recovery aligns with D3FEND recovery, restoration, and service continuity techniques.

metadata.remarks: Disaster Recovery defines the capability to restore systems and services following large-scale disruptions such as datacenter outages, cloud region failures, or natural disasters. Control implementation is expressed at the capability level to ensure predictable, tested recovery outcomes.

components.title: Recovery Architecture and Sites
components.description: Defined disaster recovery environments, secondary regions, or alternate sites.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Alternate processing sites are established and managed to support disaster recovery.

components.title: Failover and Failback Processes
components.description: Controlled procedures to transition services to and from disaster recovery environments.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Failover and recovery mechanisms support restoration of services after disasters.
Disaster recovery procedures are documented and maintained as part of contingency planning.

components.title: RTO and RPO Management
components.description: Definition, governance, and validation of recovery time and recovery point objectives.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Disaster recovery plans are tested to verify achievement of defined RTO and RPO objectives.
